blocks.text: ANGELES CITY — Operatives of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) have arrested a 47-year-old Korean national and his 31-year-old Filipina girlfriend for allegedly duping other Koreans into giving them P4 million. They were arrested as soon as they accepted an additional P1.6 million from their victims during an entrapment operation at Barangay Cutcut
